class UnusedSendPayload19 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }

function unusedSendMiddle19() { global $child; echo "M|"; try { $result = yield from ($child = unusedSendChild19()); echo "Q|", $result, "|"; return 29; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function unusedSendOuter19() { global $middle; echo "O|"; try { yield from ($middle = unusedSendMiddle19()); echo "Z|"; return 31; } finally { echo "T|"; } }
echo "P|"; $outer = unusedSendOuter19(); $outer->rewind(); echo "H|", $outer->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
$snapshot = $middle->send(new UnusedSendPayload19()); echo "S|", $snapshot, "|"; unset($snapshot); echo "N|";
$outer->next(); echo "V|", $child->current(), "|"; $outer->next(); echo "G|", $outer->getReturn(), "|";
unset($outer, $middle, $child); echo "E";
purpose: Pending shared SEND to a bare yield ignores and destroys its owning argument before caller output, without advancing; a later real forwarded next resumes the child and its source tail.
